body: "What is my intention?" means what do 1really want? Do Iwant to be Free? Do 1really want to be Free? Am Iwilling to sacrifice for that Freedom? If so, how much am 1willing to sacrifice for that Freedom? How much am Iwilling to give up? How much pain am I willing to cease to be preoccupied with? How many ideas am 1willing to part with? How many ideas about Enlightenment am 1willing to let go of? Looking seriously into questions like these reveals the clarity or lack of clarity of your intention. 2 5
